application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
decision_conditions: The rear garden shall not be used as an outdoor play area by children attending the childminding use hereby permitted before 10:00 or after 16:00 on any day when the childminding use is in operation.Reason: To safeguard the residential amenities of neighbouring occupiers and the character of the surrounding residential area.

Prior to the first use of the premises for the childminding use hereby permitted, details of any means of enclosure, gates or barriers associated with vehicle, pedestrian and cycle access shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall be implemented prior to first use of the childminding use and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that safe, secure and accessible access arrangements are provided for vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists, and to safeguard the visual appearance and functionality of the site.

No new wall, fence, gate, hedge, planting or other structure shall exceed 0.6 metres in height within 2 metres of either side of the vehicular access point(s), and the visibility splays shall thereafter be retained clear of obstruction. Reason: To ensure adequate visibility for drivers entering and leaving the site, and to safeguard pedestrian and highway safety.

The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Site Location Map 00017/E/00 Dated 17.04.2026;Existing Block Plan 00017/E/01 Dated 17.04.2026;Existing Ground Floor Plan 00017/E/2 Dated 17.04.2026;Existing First Floor Plan 00017/E/3 Dated 17.04.2026;Existing Loft Floor Plan 00017/E/4 Dated 17.04.2026;Existing Roof Plan 00017/E/5 Dated 17.04.2026;Existing Section A-A	00017/E/7 Dated 17.04.2026;Existing Elevations 00017/E/6 Dated 17.04.2026;Proposed Block Plan 00017/P/01 Dated 17.04.2026;Proposed Ground Floor Plan	00017/P/2 Dated 17.04.2026;Proposed First Floor Plan 00017/P/3 Dated 17.04.2026;Proposed Loft Plan 00017/P/4 Dated 17.04.2026;Proposed Section A-A 00017/P/7 Dated 17.04.2026;Proposed Elevations 00017/P/6 Dated 17.04.2026;Proposed Roof Plan 00017/P/5 Dated 17.04.2026;Highway Safety Impact Assessment;Planning Statement;Design and Access Statement;Existing Photographic Evidence 00017/E/8 Dated 17.04.2026.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), the childminding and accountancy/management consultancy activities hereby permitted shall remain ancillary to the primary use of the property as a single dwellinghouse within Use Class C3 and shall not operate as independent commercial uses. The property shall not be used solely or primarily for childminding, accountancy or management consultancy purposes, and the residential use of the property shall remain the dominant use at all times.Reason: To ensure that the approved business activities remain limited in scale and ancillary to the primary residential use of the property, in the interests of safeguarding the residential character of the area and the amenities of neighbouring occupiers.

The childminding use hereby permitted shall operate only between the hours of 07:30 and 18:30 Monday to Friday, and shall not operate on Saturdays, Sundays or Bank/Public Holidays. No more than 6 children receiving childminding services shall be present at the property at any one time. The childminding use shall be operated by no more than 3 members of staff, all of whom shall be resident at the property, and no non-resident staff shall be employed or based at the premises in connection with the childminding use.Reason: To ensure that the childminding use remains limited in scale and ancillary to the primary residential use of the property, and to safeguard the residential amenities of neighbouring occupiers and the character of the surrounding residential area.
description: Use of the dwellinghouse for a mixed residential and home-based business use comprising childminding and accounting, management and consultancy services by the resident occupiers.
subdivision_of_building: Ground floor to be residential and commercial but first floor to be residential only.
